regression-full.title: Possible overfitting
regression-full.message: Lowest logged eval/loss in this finite segment was 1.271 at step 7; the last value is 2.198 (72.9%, slope diagnostic p<0.0001). Within their shared interval, train/loss trends down (294 readings, steps 7-300) while eval/loss trends up (294 readings, steps 7-300). This is consistent with overfitting, but does not establish its cause.
fixes: If a checkpoint was saved near step 7, compare it with the last saved checkpoint on the same evaluation examples.
Check evaluation-data and metric-definition changes before attributing the rise to training.
If the regression persists on a comparable evaluation set, consider early stopping, regularization, or more training data.

fixed-cohort-switch.title: Evaluation values fluctuate
fixed-cohort-switch.message: eval/loss changes direction 18 times across 20 finite observations. Its median absolute adjacent change is 100% of the observed range. This describes the logged curve; it does not measure evaluation uncertainty or establish whether checkpoints differ.
fixes: Check whether evaluation data, sampling, or metric definitions changed between logged values.
To compare saved checkpoints, evaluate them on the same examples and retain paired per-example scores; account for dependent examples.
Repeated evaluation only measures randomness present in that procedure; repeating a deterministic pass does not measure uncertainty across examples.
